# Cloud Modular - Complete Information

> Precision-engineered modular construction for Western Australia and Australia

## Company Profile

**Name**: Cloud Modular
**Industry**: Modular Construction / Prefabricated Buildings
**Headquarters**: Loftus St, North Perth, Western Australia 6006, Australia
**Manufacturing**: Foshan City, Guangdong Province, China
**Website**: https://cloudmodular.com.au
**Email**: info@cloudmodular.com.au

## Executive Summary

Cloud Modular is a precision-engineered modular construction company delivering prefabricated buildings certified to Australian standards. We combine architectural design, offsite manufacturing capability, and rigorous engineering certification to provide developers and builders with a controlled, predictable construction process.

Our system addresses key construction industry challenges: labour shortages, rising costs, tight timelines, and compliance complexity. By manufacturing modules in controlled factory environments, we deliver projects faster, with greater quality consistency and cost certainty.

## Technical Specifications

### What's Included in Every Module

- **Structural Systems**: Durable steel frame construction engineered for Australian conditions
- **Exterior Finishes**: Quality cladding and weatherproofing tailored to design requirements
- **Interior Fit-Out**: Complete interiors with flooring, walls, ceiling systems, and cabinetry
- **Mechanical Systems**: HVAC, plumbing, and electrical systems pre-installed and tested
- **Compliance & Certification**: All documentation and certifications for Australian building standards
- **Installation Support**: Expert on-site crew for seamless module placement and connections

### Quality Assurance

1. **Engineering Certification**: Each module is certified by qualified engineers
2. **Factory-Controlled Production**: Stable, repeatable environment for consistent quality
3. **Independent Quality Checks**: Inspections at key stages verify accuracy and workmanship

## Frequently Asked Questions

### Compliance & Standards

**Q: How do your modules comply with Australian standards?**
A: All modules are engineered to Australian standards and certified before leaving the factory. We provide full documentation and drawings for building surveyors and local authorities.

**Q: Where are the modules built?**
A: Modules are manufactured in controlled factory environments offshore, where the process is stable, repeatable and closely audited for accuracy and consistency.

**Q: How do you ensure quality when manufacturing offshore?**
A: We use controlled factory settings, third-party inspections and engineering sign-off at key points in the process. Nothing ships until it meets structural, architectural and compliance requirements.

### Process & Timeline

**Q: What's the advantage of modular over traditional construction?**
A: Most of the build happens offsite, which shortens timelines, reduces site disruption and improves cost certainty.

**Q: What's the typical project timeline?**
A: Timelines vary by scale and complexity, but offsite manufacturing means construction and site works can run concurrently, significantly reducing the overall program.

**Q: How are modules transported and installed?**
A: Modules are shipped, unloaded and craned into position using established lifting and transport methods. We coordinate with local contractors for foundations, services and final works.

### Customisation & Flexibility

**Q: Can modular buildings be customised to my project?**
A: Yes. Modules are designed to suit site constraints, planning requirements and spatial needs. We adapt layouts and configurations based on project intent.

**Q: What types of buildings do you deliver?**
A: We work across commercial, multi-residential, health and aged care, education, community, infrastructure and accommodation projects.

### Quality & Longevity

**Q: Do modular buildings have the same lifespan as traditional buildings?**
A: Yes. Modules are engineered as permanent structures and use materials and systems comparable to traditional builds.

### Cost & Sustainability

**Q: What are the cost benefits?**
A: Factory production reduces waste, labour time and rework, providing more cost certainty and a more predictable project budget.

**Q: Can modular buildings meet sustainability targets?**
A: Yes. Controlled production reduces waste, and the precision of the process supports higher-performing building envelopes and reduced embodied carbon depending on specification.
